SecretService.luau.description: Secret Service provides the service implementation used by the Secretservice package. Public entry points include `sortKeys`, `SecretService.Init`, `SecretService.Start`, `SecretService.SetEncryptionSeed`, `SecretService.SetPublicKeySeed`, `SecretService.SetPublicSeed`, `SecretService.PromiseSecret`, `SecretService.GetSecret`.
